propositions: A check whose pass or fail result is indistinguishable from the producer never running or emitting nothing cannot be relied upon to detect the condition it is supposed to verify.

Nine instances of fail-open oracle defects were found split across two populations: five in shipped error-handling code and four in test-oracle code, requiring language additions to both existing criteria rather than creating a new criterion.

The fail-open pattern has a mirror case where a false alarm is produced (definite failing result for wrong reason), requiring the criterion to cover any definite result—pass or fail—not just passing results.

Producer-liveness language must be added to code-review-tests.md for absence assertions in test code and to code-review-base.md for silent lookup misses, unchecked returncodes, and self-matching process queries in shipped code.

Calibration replay on 18 seeded diffs (9 pre-fix recall cases and 9 post-fix no-fire cases) must achieve 9/9 firing on pre-fix with quoted claims naming the fail-open defect and 9/9 silence on post-fix to validate the criterion placement.
